Resolves #21806

🌿 The line under a timeline grid's header no longer tells you where the timeline begins.

Since #21772 the header items draw the header/body boundary themselves, so the now line crosses it. Plain and tree buttons use the grid's border token; the timeline header used the timeline's token. In `neo-theme-neo-dark`, the Portal's default theme, those are `#1D2E62` and `#262f3d`, so the one line changed colour where the timeline starts. The timeline header's inset now takes `--grid-container-border-color`, at rest and on `:hover`. That is the colour `grid/header/Toolbar.css` drew the whole boundary in before #21772, and the colour of the row lines below it. The scale's own lines (tier separator, tick separators) keep `--neo-timeline-border-color`. The geometry #21679 fixed is untouched.

Evidence: L3 (computed-style e2e across Gantt and scheduler in `neo-light` and `neo-dark`, plus 2× DPR boundary frames) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-3).

Prescription checked: `resources/css/src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.css` — owns the concern: its sibling rule (`:5-10`) already colours the plain buttons' edge with the grid token, and a theme-token change would also recolour the scale's tick lines. Ticket authored this session, so intake ran only that check. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the pre-commit theme checks (coverage, value files, var references) ran green.
